method: Fresh original A2 embedded full letters, upper zones, lower shapes, complete words and numbered complete-unit contexts, with exact same-font positive and competing local controls. Only diagnostically preserved source geometry supplies a point; a bridge neither automatically rejects nor certifies it. Opaque natural feet, filled bodies, pinholes or canonical spellings do not establish point presence or absence. S3Y29 yod carries forward the immediately preceding exact-letter challenge explicitly. All archived native and integer nearest-neighbor images freshly reproduce from the original PDF. No OCR, grammar, expected spelling, translation, enhancement, reconstruction, filtering or independent-new-witness assumption.

accepted.finding: The full qof preserves its ordinary left descender, with a rightward lower horizontal crossbar narrowing into a deep central drop and rounded lower button. This complete additional contour matches the literal same-font qamats in ESG3:11 קראו; the same-page qof patah in18 התקבל has a shallow crossbar without that lower stem/button. Root and wisdom_pass3 independently accepted U+05B8 only after complete glyphs, full words and numbered source context. No hiriq-frame, grammatical expectation or spelling inference supplies the point.
